question.instructions: What is the main intent of this comment on our post?

criteria.ready_to_buy: wants to purchase, sign up, asks for price/link/DM to buy now
criteria.question: asks for information or clarification, no clear buying intent yet
criteria.complaint: unhappy about the product, service, delivery or brand
criteria.praise: compliments, thanks or positive feedback with no question
criteria.spam: self-promotion, bots, scams, links unrelated to the post
criteria.other: anything else: jokes, tags of friends, off-topic chatter
